title: Software Engineering Technical Leader - Wireless
description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 09/05/2026Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.
  
  

Meet the Team
  
  

Cisco Meraki's Wireless team develops and maintains the world's leading cloud\-managed WLAN Access Point ecosystem, serving millions of active devices across the globe. Our mission is to simplify technology so customers can focus on what matters most—their students, patients, customers, and businesses. The MR firmware team is a collaborative group of highly experienced software engineers with diverse technical backgrounds, working on everything from leading\-edge wireless protocols to architectural innovations and customer\-impacting optimizations. We're passionate about delivering wireless solutions that simply work, and we're excited to tackle the next generation of performance and capability challenges in 802\.11 standards and beyond.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

As a Lead Firmware Engineer on the Wireless Performance team, you will drive the evaluation and optimization of performance on MR Access Point devices, directly impacting millions of customers worldwide. Solve functional and performance\-related regressions in our Access Point firmware while actively developing features aligned with emerging 802\.11 and networking standards, ensuring we maintain both innovation and legacy compatibility. Design and implement next\-level data plane optimizations by evaluating existing components, identifying performance bottlenecks, and collaborating across teams to deliver novel solutions. Develop comprehensive tests and processes to proactively triage and resolve performance and functional issues, working with the team to establish processes that elevate product quality. Lead small\-to\-medium features from technical design through completion, advocating for customer\-centric improvements and articulating design choices grounded in market awareness and competitive positioning.
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field with 8\+ years of total software engineering experience or Master's with 6\+ years of total software engineering experience
* 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience in production environments using C or C\+\+ programming
* Prior experience with Wi\-Fi drivers and firmware, including direct collaboration with Wi\-Fi vendors to triage, open, and resolve technical issues
* Experience working in Linux and/or embedded systems environments with knowledge of TCP/IP and UDP protocols
* Applied experience with 802\.11 wireless standards and core network protocols (DNS, DHCP, VLANs), including analyzing Wireshark packet captures for debugging and root cause analysis


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Deep understanding of system performance optimizations including system/traffic profiling and performance\-oriented data structure and algorithm development
* Hands\-on experience with performance testing tools such as iperf, Ixia Traffic Generators (Ixia Chariot, iGen), and equivalent platforms
* Experience with hardware and software acceleration paradigms including DPDK, VPP, multi\-threading, or similar technologies
* Proficiency with Yocto build systems and embedded Linux development
* AI\-first development mindset with demonstrated experience using modern AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or Codex


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Business Intelligence Consultant
description:
Location: Salt Lake City, Utah

On\-site five days a week

No remote or hybrid option

Full\-time contract with the potential to convert to a permanent position

Ellofant is a modern consulting firm built for those who want to do work that actually moves the needle. We help companies navigate change, complexity, and scale through a blend of strategic thinking, trusted technology, and hands\-on execution. Our clients rely on us not just for advice, but for building systems, launching products, and driving outcomes that matter. At Ellofant, we value clarity over jargon, momentum over perfection, and people over process. We're looking for curious, driven individuals who want to solve real problems with real impact. If you're excited about challenging what's possible and delivering meaningful change while you're at it, Ellofant might be your next move.

**About the role**

Ellofant is looking for a Platform Strategy Lead to own the business side of a new platform being built to help a division inside a Fortune 50 financial services firm manage its future. This is not an analytics dashboard project. This is a business platform. It will absorb the personal workflows, hand built spreadsheets, and scattered source systems the division runs on today, and give operators one place to see, decide, and act.

You will be the business's expert on process, data, and the shape of the future operating model. You will own requirements end to end and translate them into a solution that lets the business build its own views, generate insights, dispatch alerts, and take action, without waiting on engineering for every question. Views and dashboards are one surface of this platform. They are not the point. The point is a system the division uses to run itself.

This is a business architect role in everything but title. Technology partners should not have to interrupt operators to understand what needs to be built. You absorb that interruption and give tech teams a clear, defensible picture of what good looks like. You are not the person writing production pipelines, shipping code, or building models. You are the person who defines what needs to exist, brings analytical rigor to how the business thinks about its own data, and holds the vision until it is real.

**What you will do**

* Own the business side of the platform, from vision through delivery, in a division that today runs on Excel packs, hand built workflows, and stitched together source systems
* Shape what the platform becomes. Not just what it reports, but what it manages. Workflows, alerts, actions, state changes that flow back to source systems, and the surfaces the business uses to run the division day to day
* Become the deepest business expert on how work happens today, sitting alongside the operators, mapping the data flows, and understanding the rhythm of the year and the moments when decisions actually get made
* Design the future state. Views, KPIs, alerts, and the source to action loop that closes the gap between insight and change in the underlying systems
* Bring analytical rigor to how the business defines its own metrics. Interrogate calculations, question assumptions, and force clarity on what a number actually measures before it becomes a KPI
* Write and hold requirements. Own the backlog from the business side and translate needs into specifications technology can act on without second guessing
* Serve as the primary point of contact for technology partners. Answer their questions, sharpen their scope, and protect operators from meeting fatigue
* Read the existing tooling landscape. Understand what operators do today in Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, and Excel, and define what the platform needs to absorb, replace, or leave alone
* Lead the awareness campaign for the new platform inside the division. Rally the business around a shared vision of the future of work
* Measure success not by dashboards shipped but by the shift in how the division spends its time

**What we are looking for**

* At least seven years of relevant experience in platform strategy, business architecture, analytics strategy, business intelligence, data science, or analytics consulting, ideally inside financial services
* Direct experience shaping a business platform or operating system that a function used to run itself. Not just a reporting layer, but a system that connected views, decisions, alerts, and actions back to source data
* Analytical mindset with real depth. You are comfortable with statistical thinking, hypothesis framing, and interrogating a dataset before drawing conclusions from it. Formal data science background welcome, though this role is not a modeling or production data science role
* Fluency with Alteryx, Power BI, and Tableau as a power user and requirements owner. You understand what these tools let people do, where they run out of runway, and how to define what should replace them. You are not the technical implementer who ships production pipelines
* Working literacy in SQL and Python or R, enough to explore a dataset, sanity check a calculation, and speak the language of the data science and engineering teams you work with. You are not expected to write production code
* A track record of translating business needs into a modern data and application platform. Warehouse or lakehouse, semantic layer, dashboards, alerting, workflow, and write back to source systems
* Experience leading programs where you owned the business side end to end, from discovery through delivery
* Fluent in both the operator's morning and the platform team's roadmap. You translate between them without losing anything in either direction
* A systems thinker who can hold the enterprise plan, the execution layer, and the metrics layer in mind at once, and see where they should connect
* A quiet force who influences without formal authority. You get sponsors, operators, and engineers pointed at the same outcome through clarity, not escalation
* A storyteller. You can turn a data model into a narrative a division head cares about
* Someone who understands that a spreadsheet is a signal. Every personal workflow inside the business is telling you where the platform failed and what to build next
* Comfort with ambiguity. Some of the ask will not be written down. Your job includes finding it
* Ability to work on\-site in Salt Lake City five days a week

**Nice to have**

* Direct exposure to Internal Audit, Risk, or Compliance functions inside a bank
* Formal training in statistics, data science, or a quantitative discipline
* Experience with platform rebrands or awareness campaigns that shifted how a function saw itself
* Familiarity with configurable low code platforms, API driven architectures, event driven alerting patterns, and workflow systems

**How we expect AI to be used**

We want someone who knows how to use AI to work faster and more effectively. AI can help with research, analysis, first drafts, documentation, and presentation development.

AI will never replace thoughtful work, sound judgment, or attention to detail. Anything created with AI must be reviewed in detail, verified, tailored to the audience, and improved before it is shared. Generic or lightly edited AI output will not meet the quality expected in this role.

**What success looks like**

You bring structure to unclear problems and help stakeholders turn their ideas into a system that can actually be built and used. Your requirements are detailed and easy to follow. Your data models and calculations are thoughtful and accurate. Your presentations are clear, polished, and appropriate for senior leadership.

Most importantly, you earn the trust of the people you work with and help move the platform forward.

**Why This Role Matters**

If you get satisfaction from being the person a division turns to when it wants to understand its own data, from shaping the platform a business function will use to run itself going forward, and from knowing your work directly changes how people spend their days, this is your role. You will be the business's brain trust on data, process, and platform inside one of the world's largest financial services firms, and the system you help shape will define how the division works.

We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, termination, and other conditions of employment.

description:
**Who we are**


With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

**What****we need**


As a Staff Quality Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical leader and subject matter expert for electrical and electronic quality across Symbotic products. You will provide quality leadership throughout the design, development, industrialization, production, and field lifecycle of complex electrical and electronic systems, including electronic control units, power distribution systems, PCBAs, electrical assemblies, and related subsystems.

============


At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production\-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.


Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M\+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000\+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (\+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

**About The Team:**
-------------------

  

GTM Engineering builds the AI agents, systems, and automation that power how our go\-to\-market teams work. We partner across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and other GTM functions to identify high\-leverage problems and build solutions that improve speed, quality, and scale. Our work spans four core areas:

* Identify — find high\-leverage GTM workflows where AI can meaningfully improve how we operate
* Build — design, build, and deploy production AI agents and automated workflows across GTM
* Enable — drive adoption through thoughtful rollouts, playbooks, best practices, and ongoing enablement
* Evangelize — share what we build and learn externally through content, demos, talks, and open source examples

**About The Role:**
-------------------


You'll own the health, cost, performance, and business impact of the GTM Agent, and build the feedback loops that keep it improving. Because we build the platform we run on, you'll also operate the agent on LangSmith the way we tell customers to, and turn that practice into the reference story enterprises keep asking us for. *You'll work across Python 3\.11, FastAPI, LangGraph, DeepAgents, LangSmith, Supabase Postgres, BigQuery, Anthropic and OpenAI models, and Slack and Next.js surfaces.*

* Monitor production health across every graph, catching errors, slow runs, expensive runs, and silent failures before reps report them
* Triage incoming issues from Slack, tickets, and rep reports, fixing small things directly and routing the rest to the right owner
* Run the weekly eval suite, investigate failures, and turn real production bugs into permanent regression tests
* Track cost and latency by model, graph, use case, and role, and recommend concrete changes to model choice, reasoning effort, and caching
* Track usage and adoption per rep and per feature, and own the weekly health report the team runs on
* Build the business metrics that show leadership what the agent is worth, from reply rates and meetings booked to hours reclaimed and ROI
* Build our own monitoring and alerting on LangSmith, and write the “how we run our own agent” story for customers

**What You'll Bring:**
----------------------

* Strong production Python and SQL, comfortable working in traces, logs, and warehouse tables
* Real experience running LLM applications, including tracing, evals, and prompt and cache mechanics
* SRE or production operations instincts: percentiles, SLOs, and separating noise from real pattern
* Healthy skepticism about metrics; you check what a number actually counts before you publish it
* Clear writing, and interest in publishing what you learn
* High agency; you notice what's missing and take initiative to build it

**Nice to Haves:**
------------------

* LangGraph or LangSmith experience
* Experience building an eval suite from scratch
* BigQuery or dbt
* Prior DevRel\-adjacent writing
* Empathy for sales and go\-to\-market users


Salary: $150,000 \- $190,000

**Compensation Philosophy:**


We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. Actual compensation and offerings will vary based on role, level, and location. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

============


Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in\-office days in the US and more.

Our Quality Engineering \& Assurance team is the innovative engine at our company. This is an exciting opportunity to move beyond traditional QA and dive into the world of AI\-driven testing, helping us build and maintain robust quality standards for our mission\-critical intelligent applications that are redefining customer interaction. Key Responsibilities
  
Design, develop, and maintain test automation frameworks using Java and Python. Write clean, efficient, and scalable automation scripts for new features to ensure robust test coverage across all deliverables.
  
**Perform API testing:** Understand API concepts, develop and execute functional tests, interpret Swagger YAML files, and validate endpoints using Postman or Rest Assured automation frameworks.
  
**Conduct database testing:** Write and execute SQL queries to retrieve, update, and delete data, ensuring database integrity and reliability.
  
**Own quality for assigned features and components:** Collaborate with product managers and developers on requirements analysis, create detailed test cases, execute comprehensive test suites (functional, integration, regression), and provide final quality sign\-off.

**Implement and execute test plans for AI/ML applications:** Support QA activities and certify the quality of AI\-powered systems, including hands\-on testing of chatbots for intent recognition, conversational flow, response accuracy, and edge case handling.
  
**Leverage modern AI tools to enhance workflow:** Utilize AI code assistants like GitHub Copilot to accelerate test script development and explore generative AI for tasks such as test data creation and bug report summarization.
  
**Ensure AI reliability and fairness:** Execute test cases to identify issues related to bias, fairness, and model robustness, contributing to the overall trustworthiness of AI systems.
  
Develop and maintain test automation scripts and frameworks using Java and Python.
  
Have proficiency with test and defect management tools, particularly JIRA or any similar tools. Required Skills \& Qualifications

0 – 1 years of professional experience in a Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering role.

title: Robotics Autonomy Engineer
description:
Full\-time, exempt
Boston, Massachusetts
On\-site, five days per week
Reports to the CTO ***ABOUT US***
Cleo Robotics builds unconventional autonomous robotic systems designed to operate in the world’s most challenging and inaccessible environments. Our mission is to deploy intelligent machines into critical environments to improve operational efficiency, reduce unplanned downtime, and keep people out of harm’s way. Our technology is used across industries including energy, oil and gas, manufacturing, public safety, and defense. We’re a growing team of experts in robotics and autonomous systems with diverse backgrounds and skills. We value making an impact, thinking big, leading with empathy, and having fun along the way.


If you get excited about solving big problems and building robots straight from science fiction, and you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, this role might be for you!

 ***ABOUT THE ROLE***
We are seeking a Robotics Autonomy Engineer to work on cutting\-edge intelligence and autonomy features for our Dronut UAV platforms. Responsibilities of the role include the development, integration, testing, and deployment of advanced artificial intelligence and autonomy algorithms which will enable Dronut to navigate in previously unknown GPS\-denied environments. You will use various sensors such as 3D LiDAR, IMU, and cameras to estimate the pose of the Dronut, and create path planning subroutines in order to accomplish a given objective or task.

 ***WHAT YOU’LL DO**** Own and advance Cleo’s autonomy stack across localization, mapping, state estimation, sensor fusion, path planning, obstacle avoidance, and mission execution
* Work across autonomy, perception, sensors, flight controls, and vehicle dynamics to solve system\-level problems and optimize real\-time performance
* Develop and harden visual\-inertial and LiDAR\-based SLAM, multi\-sensor fusion, sensor calibration, relocalization, drift management, and map persistence
* Develop perception and reactive autonomy for obstacle detection, free\-space understanding, dynamic replanning, and safe navigation through changing and unpredictable environments
* Build autonomous behaviors including path following, mission execution, data collection, health monitoring, fault detection, redundancy, graceful degradation, recovery, and safe return behaviors
* Take cutting\-edge robotics research and turn it into reliable product capability on compute\-constrained edge hardware
* Optimize the full stack for onboard compute: profile and tune C/C\+\+ for real\-time performance within strict latency, memory, compute, power, and thermal budgets on embedded edge hardware
* Build and improve simulation, log replay, automated testing, regression benchmarks, telemetry, CI/CD, deployment, and fleet diagnostics to support reliable autonomy across a growing fleet and multiple hardware configurations
* Own real\-world autonomy performance through bench and field testing, flight\-log analysis, root\-cause debugging, and rapid product iteration
* Help define Cleo’s autonomy architecture and roadmap while operating with significant independence and ownership

 ***WHAT YOU BRING**** Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* Master's degree in Robotics, Autonomous Systems, Controls, or Computer Vision is a plus
* 3–5 years of professional experience developing autonomy, localization, state estimation, navigation, and/or flight software for robots, UAVs, autonomous vehicles, or similarly complex physical systems or equivalent demonstrated technical depth
* Proven experience deploying autonomy software on real robotic systems in the field, not just simulations or research prototypes
* Strong hands\-on experience with visual odometry, VIO, 3D mapping, sensor fusion, and SLAM, including EKF\-based estimation, calibration, and time synchronization.
* Practical experience with perception, obstacle detection, motion and path planning, trajectory generation or optimization, and map representations such as occupancy grids, octrees, etc
* Strong software engineering fundamentals with deep proficiency in C\+\+ and C, and a strong proficiency in Python. Experience with flight control software or embedded systems is highly valuable
* Able to take ideas from cutting\-edge robotics research and turn them into robust capabilities on compute\-constrained edge hardware, with experience on embedded Linux and SoCs such as Qualcomm Snapdragon or NVIDIA Jetson, including profiling and optimization using GPU, or DSP acceleration to meet real\-time performance, latency, memory, power, and compute constraints
* Uses AI tools as a core part of their daily engineering workflow to accelerate development, debugging, testing, data analysis, research, and evaluation of new approaches while maintaining strong technical judgment and ownership
* Strong ownership mentality and ability to work independently, taking ambiguous technical problems from definition through implementation, testing, and deployment with limited supervision
* Experience with ROS2, Linux, Git, Docker, and modern software practices. Experience with deployed fleets, including telemetry, fleet diagnostics, hardware compatibility, and long\-term maintainability, is a strong plus
* Communicates technical concepts, risks, and tradeoffs clearly; collaborates effectively across teams; and gives and receives technical feedback constructively.

 ***BONUS POINTS**** Experience with UAV flight stacks and multirotor control — PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, offboard control, attitude and position control loops
* Simulation and SIL/HIL experience with Gazebo, Isaac Sim, AirSim, or comparable, including closing the sim\-to\-real gap
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading a small technical team

 ***WHAT WE OFFER**** The opportunity to build autonomy that moves beyond simulation and operates on real robots in challenging, mission\-critical environments
* Meaningful ownership of a core product capability, with the ability to influence Cleo’s autonomy architecture, technical direction, and roadmap
* A high\-impact role on a small, talented team where your ideas can move rapidly from development to real\-world deployment
* The opportunity to expand your technical scope, take on greater ownership, and grow alongside the company
* Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance
* Equity for every new hire, giving everyone the opportunity to share in Cleo’s growth
* Flexible paid time off and company holidays
* A collaborative, energetic workplace with a fully stocked kitchen and regular team gatherings

 ***WORK AUTHORIZATION***
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States and must not require Cleo Robotics to sponsor, petition for, transfer, or otherwise support an employment\-based immigration status now or in the future. Cleo Robotics cannot provide employment\-based immigration sponsorship for this position.

description:
**NOCO Remodeling and Design**

**Location:** Loveland, CO

**Employment Type:** Part\-Time to Full\-Time

**Pay:** $25–$30/hour, based on experience, skills, and demonstrated ability

**This position will initially begin part\-time, with the opportunity to transition into a full\-time role based on performance and company needs.**

**IMPORTANT — How to Apply**

**To be considered, you must apply by emailing Alexa, our hiring manager, directly at alexafredrickson@gmail.com**

**\*\*\*APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED THROUGH INDEED WILL NOT BE REVIEWED\*\*\***

Please read the full posting before applying. Application instructions and four short questions are included below.

**About the Role**

NOCO Remodeling and Design is a growing Northern Colorado remodeling company specializing in bathrooms, kitchens, and home renovations. We're expanding our operations, developing our showroom, improving our systems, and incorporating AI and technology throughout the business.

We're looking for an Office Manager / Operations Coordinator who wants to help us build the company—not simply manage a list of administrative tasks.

**The most important quality we're looking for is initiative.**

If you notice a problem, investigate it and work toward solving it. If something keeps falling through the cracks, create a better system. If you don't know how to do something, research it, use the resources available to you, and figure it out.

We're looking for someone whose natural response is:

**“I'll take care of it.”**

**What You'll Do**

This role combines office management, customer communication, project coordination, and operations. Responsibilities will include:

* Answering phones and communicating professionally with customers
* Managing scheduling, appointments, calendars, and follow\-ups
* Coordinating estimates, projects, subcontractors, inspections, and customer appointments
* Helping coordinate materials, permits, and project logistics
* Keeping project information, documents, schedules, and records organized
* Assisting with proposals, estimates, invoices, and project tracking
* Following up with customers, vendors, and subcontractors
* Identifying problems early and taking ownership of finding solutions
* Creating and improving company systems and procedures
* Using AI, automation, and technology to make the business more efficient
* Anticipating what needs to happen next instead of waiting to be told

No two days will look exactly the same, and the role will evolve as the company grows.

**Who We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who is **hungry**—ambitious, motivated, hardworking, and genuinely interested in building a career.

You may be a great fit if you:

* Take initiative without needing constant direction
* Take ownership of problems from beginning to end
* Follow through until something is actually finished
* Look for answers before saying, “I don't know”
* Are highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Learn quickly and enjoy figuring things out
* Think ahead and anticipate needs
* Can prioritize when multiple things need attention
* Communicate clearly and professionally
* Handle direct feedback well
* Are comfortable respectfully challenging an idea when you see a better solution
* Want increasing responsibility and career growth

**Resourcefulness, initiative, judgment, and technological aptitude matter more to us than remodeling experience.**

We can teach you our business. It's much harder to teach someone how to think critically, take ownership, and solve problems independently.

**AI Proficiency Is a Core Requirement**

**You need to be comfortable and proficient using AI.**

We're actively incorporating AI and automation into the way NOCO Remodeling and Design operates. We're not looking for someone who has simply used ChatGPT a few times. We want someone who understands how to use AI as a practical work tool and is excited to become even better at it.

You should be comfortable using AI to research and solve problems, improve communications, organize information, create procedures and resources, learn unfamiliar tasks, improve workflows, and identify opportunities for automation.

You don't need to be a programmer or AI engineer. You **do** need to be technologically confident, capable of learning new tools quickly, and proficient enough with AI to independently use it to accomplish real work.

When you encounter something repetitive or inefficient, we want your instinct to be:

**“Is there a better way to do this—and can AI or automation help?”**

Experience with ChatGPT and other AI platforms, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, CRM/project\-management software, and workflow automation is strongly valued.

**Start Part\-Time. Grow With Us.**

This position will initially begin **part\-time** because we're focused on finding the right long\-term person.

For someone who demonstrates initiative, good judgment, problem\-solving ability, and a genuine ability to make the company more effective, our goal is to transition the position into a **full\-time role with greater responsibility, opportunity, and earning potential.**

And we're not necessarily looking for someone who wants to remain an Office Manager forever.

As NOCO Remodeling and Design grows, this position could develop into a larger role in **operations, management, and potentially company leadership.**

**If you prove that you're an asset, we want to give you more—not hold you back.**

**How to Apply**

**Do not apply through Indeed. Applications submitted through Indeed will not be reviewed.**

Email your application directly to **alexafredrickson@gmail.com** with the subject line:

**Office Manager Application – Your Name**

Please include your resume, a brief introduction, and answers to these four questions:

**1\. Tell us about a time you noticed a problem at work and solved it without being asked.**What did you do, and what was the result?

**2\. Give us a specific example of how you've used AI to solve a problem, improve a process, save time, or produce better work.**What did you use, how did you use it, and what was the result?

**3\. Tell us about something you didn't know how to do but figured out on your own.**How did you approach it?

**4\. Why does this particular opportunity interest you, and what are you hoping your role could grow into over the next few years?**

Following these instructions is the first step in the hiring process.

**Experience matters, but how you think, how you work, and what you do when nobody is telling you what to do matters more.**

We're looking for someone who wants to **help us build an exceptional company.**

title: Design Engineer
description:
**We have a lot of ideas. We need someone who can figure out how to actually make them!**

We’re looking for a rare combination of **engineer, designer, problem\-solver and maker** to join a small, highly creative team working across two very different Nashville\-based businesses: a multidisciplinary design studio and a specialty food/manufacturing company.

This isn’t a traditional engineering job.

It isn’t quite a traditional design job, either.

We’re looking for someone with an **engineering education, an excellent visual eye and a natural instinct for figuring things out.**

Someone who can take:

**inspiration → idea → model → rendering → technical drawing → prototype → real life.**

Our projects don’t stay neatly inside one discipline or scale.

One week you might draw and render a custom banquette.

The next, model a component for confectionary production.

Then you might lay out a production kitchen, develop fabrication drawings for custom millwork, troubleshoot a manufacturing problem, or help determine how a large\-scale public installation could actually be fabricated and installed.

If your brain naturally switches between **“That would be beautiful”** and **“Okay, but how are we actually going to make that?”**, we want to meet you.

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**

**Interiors \+ Environments**

You’ll help translate creative concepts into drawings and visuals that clients, developers, contractors, millworkers, fabricators and our internal team can actually use.

Projects may include architectural plans, elevations, sections and details; space planning; field measurements and as\-builts; custom millwork; furniture drawings; finish specifications; equipment layouts; construction\-document coordination; and presentation\-ready renderings.

Sometimes you’ll receive an organized brief.

Sometimes you’ll receive six inspiration photos, a sketch and a verbal explanation of something that doesn’t exist yet.

You should enjoy turning **both** into something clear.

**Visualization**

We want to see things before we make them.

You’ll create:

* Photorealistic interior renderings
* Product and furniture renderings
* Concept visualizations
* Material and finish studies
* Presentation boards
* 3D models
* Renderings of your own concepts before fabrication
* Polished visuals developed from sketches, inspiration photographs and verbal creative direction

You should be able to make something **beautiful enough to communicate the vision and accurate enough to start figuring out how to build it.**

**Products \+ Objects**

We design beyond rooms.

You’ll help develop furniture, displays, packaging, components, fixtures, trays, equipment solutions and other physical objects.

That means thinking about appearance **and** manufacturability: tolerances, clearances, hardware, connections, assembly, materials, fabrication methods, cost and what happens when a beautiful rendering meets the real world.

**Food \+ Manufacturing**

One of the businesses is a growing specialty\-food manufacturer, which gives this role an entirely different technical playground.

Projects may include:

* Rendering and technically planning a new production kitchen
* Developing kitchen and equipment layouts
* Helping evaluate new production equipment
* Improving workflow and production processes
* Helping test, calculate, document and standardize confectionery formulations alongside the production team—including ingredient ratios, **water calculations**, batch scaling and yields
* Helping design and document roasting experiments and profiles
* Developing packaging, trays, displays and production components
* Prototyping solutions to production problems
* Helping plan spaces for tours, classes and customer experiences
* Building better technical documentation and repeatable systems
* Helping prepare a growing manufacturing operation for larger\-scale retail production

You’ll work alongside the appropriate food\-science, engineering and other specialized professionals when a project requires expertise beyond your scope.

Knowing **when we don’t know enough yet** is an important part of this job.

**Fabrication \+ Engineering**

We want someone who thinks about how things actually go together.

You’ll work with:

* 2D drafting
* 3D modeling
* Millwork drawings
* Furniture drawings
* Shop drawings
* Fabrication drawings
* Exploded diagrams
* Dimensioned product drawings
* Bills of materials
* Packaging development
* Powder\-coating
* Product and component design
* Basic mechanical design
* Prototyping
* CNC\-ready design thinking
* Value engineering
* Vendor and fabricator coordination
* Troubleshooting fabrication problems

You should have working knowledge of materials such as **wood, metal, acrylic, plastics, stone and composites**, along with basic structural reasoning, hardware and fastening methods.

You don’t need to personally engineer or stamp everything. You **do** need enough technical judgment to recognize when a project needs a licensed structural, civil, MEP or other specialist and be able to collaborate effectively with them.

**THEN THERE ARE THE BIG IDEAS**

We’re building toward work at a much larger scale:

**public art → sculpture → airports → murals → streetscapes → playgrounds → amphitheaters → experiential environments.**

That could mean developing concepts and renderings, documenting sites, researching materials, thinking through fabrication and transportation, developing installation sequences, creating technical drawings, coordinating with engineers and fabricators, or helping assemble the technical pieces of a bid, RFQ or RFP.

You won’t be expected to know how to do all of that on Day One.

You **will** be expected to be excited about learning how.

**THE UNUSUAL PART**

You need to be comfortable changing scales constantly:

**interior → millwork → furniture → product → packaging → equipment → sculpture → installation.**

Monday might be a custom banquette.

Tuesday might be a candy\-production component.

Wednesday could be a production kitchen.

Thursday could be figuring out why something can’t be fabricated the way we originally imagined.

Friday might be modeling something we’ve never made before.

For the right person, that’s the best part of the job.

**SOFTWARE**

**Core**

You should be proficient in—or have a strong working foundation that allows you to quickly become proficient in:

**AutoCAD**

**SketchUp**

**Bluebeam Revu**

**Rhino, Fusion 360, SolidWorks or comparable 3D CAD software**

**Adobe Illustrator**

**Adobe Photoshop**

**Strong Bonuses**

**Revit**

**Enscape, V\-Ray, Lumion, Twinmotion or another rendering engine**

**CNC/CAM software**

**Adobe InDesign**

We don’t expect one person to be an expert in every program listed.

We care much more about whether you’re **technically capable, resourceful and extremely fast at learning.**

We also actively use AI tools—including Claude and similar platforms—for research, analysis, documentation, comparison, ideation and efficiency.

We want someone who is excited about using new technology **without confusing AI output with verified technical information.**

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

An **engineering educational background is required.**

We’re particularly interested in mechanical, industrial, manufacturing, architectural, civil, structural or closely related engineering backgrounds.

A PE license is **not required**.

Experience or portfolio work involving any of the following will immediately get our attention:

**Industrial design**  Design engineering **Architectural fabrication**  Custom millwork **Furniture design**  Product development **Experiential design**  Technical design **Fabrication engineering**

We’re especially interested in someone who has **made things**.

Professional work counts.

So do prototypes, furniture, CNC projects, personal experiments, products, models, fabrication projects and weird things you built simply because you wanted to see whether you could.

**YOUR BRAIN MATTERS AS MUCH AS YOUR RÉSUMÉ**

We want someone who is:

**Analytical.** You naturally want evidence before making assumptions.

**Critical.** You notice the thing everyone else overlooked and aren’t afraid to bring it up.

**Restorative.** Problems make you want to solve them.

**Curious.** You genuinely enjoy learning things you don’t already understand.

**Resourceful.** “I’ve never done that before” is the beginning of your research, not the end of the conversation.

**Deliberate.** You think about what could go wrong before we spend money or build something.

**Strategic.** You can see multiple paths to an outcome.

**Responsible.** If you say you’re going to figure something out, you follow it through.

**Independent.** You don’t require a traditional office or constant supervision to make meaningful progress.

And importantly, you’re comfortable disagreeing.

We’re not looking for a yes\-person.

We’re also not looking for someone whose technical expertise becomes a reason everything interesting is impossible.

Our favorite answer is:

**“That version won’t work. Here’s why—and here are two versions that could.”**

**HOW WE WORK**

This is a **Nashville\-based, hybrid and remote\-friendly role.** 

We don’t work from one traditional office every day.

Depending on the project, you may be working remotely from your laptop, at a production facility, at an interior project site, from a coworking environment or alongside members of the team.

A substantial portion of the job is independent computer\-based work.

You should be extremely comfortable being **laptop\-friendly**: taking a project with you, working independently, documenting your progress and communicating clearly about what you’ve completed, what’s unresolved and what you need from us.

You’ll also need to be based in or near Nashville and available for field measurements, site visits, fabrication meetings, installations, production troubleshooting and in\-person collaboration when the project calls for it.

If you need the same desk in the same office every day, this probably isn’t the job for you.

**CLIFTONSTRENGTHS / STRENGTHSFINDER**

We’re interested in **how you naturally think and solve problems**, not just what’s on your résumé.

Candidates who move forward in the interview process may be asked to complete the **CliftonStrengths (StrengthsFinder) assessment** and share their results as one additional conversation tool during the hiring process.

There is **no required Top 5 and no “correct” result.**

However, this position tends to reward behaviors associated with themes such as:

**Analytical**  Restorative **Learner**  Deliberative **Strategic**  Responsibility **Focus**  Achiever **Discipline**  Activator

We’re interested in understanding **how you work**, where you’re naturally strongest, and what kind of environment allows you to do your best work.

The assessment is one data point—not a pass/fail test.

**POSITION DETAILS**

**Title:** Design Engineer / Technical Designer

**Location:** Nashville, Tennessee

**Work Style:** Hybrid \+ remote\-friendly

**Schedule:** Approximately 15–20 combined hours/week to start, with opportunity to grow

**Employment:** Two part\-time W\-2 positions across two related businesses

**Start:** Fall 2026

**Review:** 90\-day review

The role is intentionally flexible. Some weeks may lean more heavily toward design work; others toward manufacturing, product development or technical problem\-solving.

**TO APPLY**

Please send:

**1\. Your résumé**

**2\. A portfolio or relevant work samples.** This is important. We’re just as interested in seeing what you’ve made as where you’ve worked.

**3\. A short introduction answering this question:**

**Tell us about something you designed, built, engineered or figured out that you’re particularly proud of. What was the problem, and how did you approach it?**

Your portfolio does not need to look like a traditional architecture portfolio.

Show us drawings. Renderings. Models. Products. Furniture. Prototypes. Fabrication. Personal projects. Experiments. Things that failed and got better.

**We care a lot about how you think.**

Pay: $28\.00 \- $36\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15\.0 – 25\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Nashville, TN 37210

title: Solutions Consultant II- Trust & Safety
description:
**About Stream**
----------------


Stream powers chat, video, activity feeds, and moderation for over a billion end users. From Amsterdam to Boulder to Techstars, we've raised over $58\.25M to build the best Chat, Video, Feeds, and Moderation infrastructure available, with best\-in\-class support. We're 120\+ people across 35 nationalities, and we've been at this for over a decade.


Our AI Moderation product is one of the fastest\-growing parts of the platform. Customers use it to detect harmful text, images, video, and audio in real time — configuring policies, harm categories, blocklists, and automated actions, then reviewing what's left in a moderation queue their teams live in every day. When it's tuned well, it protects communities and saves moderators from work no one should have to do. When it's tuned poorly, false positives frustrate good users and real harm slips through. That gap is what this role exists to close.

**The role**
------------


You'll own the customer side of Trust \& Safety: getting new customers live, keeping their detection accurate as their communities evolve, and making their Trust \& Safety teams genuinely good at using the product.


This is a customer\-facing role with a hands\-on technical edge. You won't be shipping product code, but you will be in the dashboard configuring policies, reading through flagged content to understand why a rule misfired, poking at API responses, and building the reports that show a customer whether their moderation is actually working. You'll be the person a Head of Trust \& Safety calls when their false\-positive rate spikes — and the person who tells our product and engineering teams what needs to change.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Onboarding and implementation**

* Run moderation onboarding end\-to\-end: kickoff, policy design, configuration, testing, and go\-live for new customers.
* Translate a customer's written community guidelines into working configuration — policies, harm categories, thresholds, blocklists, and automated actions.
* Partner with customer engineering teams on integration questions, webhook setup, and moderation events flowing into their systems.
* Set a clear go\-live bar with each customer and hold the project to it, keeping stakeholders on both sides aligned on timeline and open items.

**Continuous improvement and tuning**

* Own ongoing tuning: review flagged and missed content, diagnose false positives and false negatives, and adjust configuration to improve precision and recall.
* Investigate escalations when moderation behaves unexpectedly, and drive them to root cause with our engineering team.
* Turn patterns across accounts into product feedback, and advocate internally for the changes that would fix them at the source.

**Customer enablement**

* Train moderators and T\&S leads on the review queue, dashboard, rule builder, and reporting — and make them fast in it.
* Build the enablement layer this function needs: onboarding playbooks, configuration templates by vertical, best\-practice guides, tuning checklists, internal runbooks.
* Support renewals and expansion by making the value of the product visible: business reviews, usage narratives, and outcomes tied to the customer's own goals.

**Cross\-functional work**

* Work closely with Sales and Solutions Engineering on late\-stage deals, pilots, and proof\-of\-concepts where implementation reality matters.
* Feed the product roadmap with prioritized, evidence\-backed customer needs.
* Help scale the function as the customer base grows — including documenting what you do so the next hires ramp faster than you did.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3\+ years in a customer\-facing role at a technical or SaaS company — customer success, implementation, solutions consulting, technical account management, professional services, or Trust \& Safety operations with external stakeholders.
* Comfortable being technical without being an engineer
* Strong project management instincts. You can run several onboardings at once and keep every one of them honest about where it stands.
* Analytical: you're drawn to the question "is this actually working?" and you know how to answer it with data rather than vibes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You can hold a room of moderators in a training session and a room of executives in a business review, and adjust accordingly.
* Willingness to engage with difficult content. This role involves reviewing examples of harmful material — harassment, hate speech, NSFW imagery, and similar — as part of tuning and diagnosis. We take reviewer wellbeing seriously and will talk openly about this in the process.
* Based in or willing to relocate to the Boulder, CO area, with 3 days per week in our Boulder office.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Direct Trust \& Safety, content moderation, or community operations experience — in\-house at a platform, at a BPO/vendor, or at a moderation tooling company.
* Familiarity with moderation and safety concepts: policy taxonomies, harm categories, precision/recall tradeoffs, appeals, CSAM reporting obligations.
* Working knowledge of online safety regulation (DSA, OSA, COPPA, EU AI Act).
* Experience with chat, social, gaming, marketplace, or dating platforms — the verticals where moderation matters most.
* Experience building enablement content or customer\-facing documentation from scratch.

**Why this role is worth your time**
------------------------------------

* Moderation is a growth priority at Stream, and this is an early hire on the customer side of it — you'll shape how the function works rather than inherit a process.
* The work is unusually visible. Trust \& Safety leaders make buying decisions based on whether onboarding and tuning are good, and you own both.

**Why join Stream?**
--------------------

* **History of success.** From Amsterdam to Boulder and Techstars in\-between, Stream has raised over $58\.25M to build the best Chat Messaging \& Activity Feed infrastructure available, with best\-in\-class support.
* **Freedom and endless growth opportunities.** As a rapidly growing startup (since 2020 we have gone from 30 to 150 employees), Stream gives you unique personal and professional growth opportunities. The opportunity of true ownership and accountability has a massive impact on your career. These are the things you can rarely experience in huge corporations.
* **Be on the front line of progress and innovation.** While working with cutting\-edge technology, we are passionate about tackling difficult tech problems at scale and creating reusable components for them, empowering engineering teams to ship apps faster, more securely, and with a better user experience.
* **They believe in us:** Stream is backed by leading VC companies (Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01\.Advisors, Techstars, Arthur Ventures), including backers like Dick Costolo (01 Advisors, ex\-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston\-Werner (Co\-Founder of GitHub), Nicolas Dessaigne (Co\-Founder of Algolia), Johnny Boufarhat (Founder and CEO of Hopin).

**What we have to offer you**
-----------------------------


Stream employees enjoy some of the best job benefits in the industry:

* 19\+ days of paid time off plus 10 paid holidays
* Hybrid work flexibility (3 days a week from the office)

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About the Company**
---------------------


Valon is building the AI\-native operating system for regulated finance, starting with mortgage servicing.  

  

We're a Series C company backed by a16z, transforming industries that others have written off as too complex to innovate.  

  

Rather than build on top of broken legacy systems, we took a different approach: we built and operate our own mortgage servicing business managing $110\+ billion in loans. This wasn't the end goal, it was how we deeply understood the complexity needed to build software that actually works in regulated industries.  

  

The results speak for themselves. We've transformed mortgage servicing from a 0% margin business into 60%\+ margins while dramatically improving customer experience. Major enterprise contracts are now deploying across the industry.  

  

ValonOS is our unified platform that makes every process structured and programmable and it is perfectly positioned for the AI era. When everything flows through one system with rich data, AI agents don't just automate tasks, they continuously improve entire operations. Mortgage servicing is just the beginning of our vision to transform regulated industries and beyond.

**Engineering at Valon**
------------------------


Our engineering team is here to power the software ecosystem to disrupt one of the most outdated and regulated spaces in the financial sector \- the mortgage industry. We’ve built out the foundation of a modern mortgage servicing platform that can accurately handle billions of dollars at scale, but we’re just getting started. At Valon, we want you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by a tight\-knit community of exceptional people from places like Stripe, Jane Street, Meta, and Google who care deeply about their work and each other. Our problem space is complex, but you’ll get a lot of autonomy so that you can learn quickly, execute effectively, and deliver the highest level of business impact.


We have offices in New York City and San Francisco. Plus, we fully support remote work!


**About the Role**
------------------


We’re looking for an engineering manager to support Valon’s growing engineering team. In this role, you’ll lead 4\+ engineers across one or more teams, working closely with your reports and partnering with product, design, and operations to build the future of Valon. You’ll empower your team through mentorship, defining long term strategy, strong technical leadership, business acumen, and more to ensure maximum impact and business value. * Define and evangelize new processes to make your team more effective and deliver an outsized impact.
* Push for continuous improvements and innovation using data\-driven decisions.

* Tech Lead or Engineering Management experience preferred.
* At least 4\+ years of software engineering experience.
* Demonstrated track record of building and empowering long lasting teams.
* Experience working in a highly complex and technical environment.
* Experience working in a fast paced and ambiguous startup environment.
* Passion for providing the biggest impact with inventive resource planning.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrates excellent judgment, problem solving, and decision making.

------------

* Compensation: competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity, and 401k plan. NB: The base salary range reflects multiple levels. We assess level based on a combination of past experience and interview performance
* Health \& well\-being: we’ll invest in your physical and mental well\-being with comprehensive medical, dental, \& vision benefits

title: Sales Engineer
description:
#### **About The Position**


**About the Position**


Pixellot is the world leader in automated video and data solutions for youth and amateur sports, with over 25,000 AI\-enabled venues worldwide capturing over 2 million hours of content. We're building the platform that keeps every game in play AI cameras, automated production, streaming, analytics, and monetization and we need someone who can own the field when a deal is on the line.


We're looking for a hands\-on Sales Engineer who can join active sales opportunities and turn customer needs into working technical solutions. You’ll meet with prospects, understand their technical requirements, and build tailored proofs of concept using scripts, integrations, APIs, data connections, or other practical solutions needed to demonstrate the value of our platform.


You’ll also work closely with our R\&D teams in Europe and Israel, so flexibility to collaborate across time zones is important. Internally, you’ll act as the technical link between Sales, Product, and R\&D validating what is technically feasible, helping shape solutions, and making sure we set the right expectations with customers before commitments are made.

**As part of your role, you will:**

* Drive Pre\-Sales Prototyping: Partner with Sales on strategic opportunities to build and present working proofs\-of\-concept (PoCs).
* Engineer Creative Solutions: Make rapid build\-vs\-simulate calls and run workarounds (scripts, temporary API bridges, data feeds) to close product gaps and prove our capabilities live.
* Translate Tech to Revenue: Present to technical and business stakeholders alike, from CTOs to league leadership, so they see the business case and monetization value, not just a demo.
* Own the Implementation: Carry the deal across the finish line partner with the customer's technical team to turn your PoC into a live integration and stay accountable through the first stable production release.
* Champion the North American Market: Be the definitive technical voice of the NA customer to our Israel\-based Product and R\&D teams, turning field feedback into structured roadmap input.
* Scale Your Wins: Turn every successful deployment into reusable assets demo environments, reference architectures, playbooks so the next deal closes even faster.


#### **Requirements**


**You should bring with you:**

* A Hands\-On, Scrappy Builder: You write code regularly (APIs, scripting, basic cloud) and have a track record of making undocumented or unfamiliar third\-party systems do what you need.
* Commercial \& Executive Presence: You confidently present live to CTOs and business leaders, handle pushback on the spot, and tie technical architecture directly to revenue.
* High Autonomy \& Good Judgment: You can take an open\-ended ask and run with it without a spec, while knowing exactly where the line sits between demonstrating a capability and overstating one.
* End\-to\-End Follow\-Through: You stay in the game after the contract is signed as motivated by a stable, live integration as by winning the deal.
* Global Collaboration: Comfortable working across North American time zones while staying tightly aligned with an R\&D team based in Israel.
* Track Record in a Deal\-Facing Technical Role: Several years of experience in pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or technical account management, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Strong Ownership \& Communication: You bring clarity to ambiguity and communicate with equal confidence to engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Background in pre\-sales, solutions engineering, hackathons, or early\-stage startups (0\-to\-1 building).

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Experience carrying a signed deal into production at a B2B SaaS company (implementation, professional services, or technical onboarding).
* Familiarity with sports technology, video/streaming pipelines, or B2B SaaS integration patterns.

**﻿**

**﻿**


#### **Why You'll Love Working Here**


* Make an Impact Where It Matters: Your work reaches millions of sports fans, athletes, families, clubs, and coaches around the world — from parents watching a Friday night game to coaches looking for their next competitive edge.
* Play with Real Technical Challenges: Build technology around real\-time video at global scale, consumer experiences that need to feel effortless, and AI capabilities that are changing how sports are captured, produced, watched, and analyzed.
* Be Part of a Strong Team: Work alongside experienced R\&D, Product, and business leaders, with talented people who care about solving real customer problems and continuously raising the bar.

* **Benefits:** We offer a full comprehensive package including healthcare, dental, vision, and a 401(k) plan.
